title: Hacer explícito el payload atómico del fast claim /wc
mission: Reconcile the /wc claim-first bootstrap with the mandatory portfolio pin payload so a fresh worker can construct a protocol-valid immutable first-generation pin from bounded preclaim state without loading deep portfolio archaeology. Add a static regression canary that prevents fast-path instructions from permitting structurally incomplete pins while preserving EFF001 claim-before-deep-context.
definition_of_done: The preclaim bootstrap or an equally bounded helper explicitly supplies every field required for a valid prometeo.portfolio-pin/v1 create, including stable pin_id/claim_id derivation, dedupe/project identity, source_head, claimed/expires timestamps and predecessor nulls for generation 1.
A fresh /wc can produce a protocol-valid atomic G000001 create without loading unrelated Guide/Metabolism/page/history context.
Pin immutability remains intact: post-create metadata repair is no longer necessary in the normal fast path.
A regression test fails if the fast-path pin payload can omit any required PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL field.
EFF001 claim-before-deep-context and the <=3 fast-attempt budget remain preserved.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion occurs.
